tools.name: facebook_download_links
tools.description: Get direct download links for a public Facebook video, reel, watch link, share link or photo post: SD and HD MP4 with audio, separate video/audio tracks, thumbnail, title and duration.

tools.name: tiktok_download_links
tools.description: Get no-watermark MP4 links (HD and SD), the music track, cover image, title and author for a public TikTok video.

tools.name: pinterest_download_links
tools.description: Get download links for the videos, images and GIFs of a public Pinterest pin or Idea Pin (pinterest.com or pin.it short links).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facebook_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facebook_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
